preserved_contracts.command_policy: CLI and Artisan remain projections of the same analyzer; exit zero means a report was produced, not upgrade feasibility.
preserved_contracts.guidance: 7->8, retained direct7->9, every adjacent8->9 through12->13; ascending contiguous paths may compose.
preserved_contracts.staging: Exactly one rooted laravel/framework target, supported ascending adjacent majors7-13, exact satisfiable stage PHP; no source remediation simulation.
preserved_contracts.immutable_evidence: Historical schemas, signed contracts and archived release fixtures are not rewritten. New tests and ledgers capture patch expectations separately.

gap_dispositions.patch_disposition: Pin public inputs, analyze baseline and candidate outside them, record actual outcomes and manual next work.
Account for every pinned guide heading; correct bounded ranges and advisories, record manual and contract-dependent work.

gap_dispositions.owner: Laravel source visitor and high-signal rules

Preserve staged refusal and direct-target fidelity; document workarounds.
gap_dispositions.handoff: v0.4 Milestones0-2: rooted-family targets and same-major version identity require explicit contract decisions.

feedback_review.method: Retrospective review of public monorepo issues and comments after the baseline release; no external solicitation.
feedback_review.issue_disposition: Release-announcement issue, no comments at review; not a reported Laravel regression.
feedback_review.limitation: Absence of filed feedback is not proof of compatibility; pinned application evaluation and guide review provide separate evidence.
